en.headline: Heung Yuen Wai permit holders can use Lok Ma Chau overnight from today
en.dek: Cross-boundary private cars with valid Heung Yuen Wai closed-road permits may cross via Lok Ma Chau between midnight and 6:30 a.m. daily under a new Guangdong-Hong Kong arrangement.
body: From 26 August, holders of valid closed-road permits for the Heung Yuen Wai Control Point may use the Lok Ma Chau Control Point to cross the boundary between midnight and 6:30 a.m. each day, the Transport Department said.

The arrangement was agreed by the governments of Guangdong and Hong Kong to allow these private cars to cross outside the normal operating hours of Heung Yuen Wai. Permit holders need only present a valid Heung Yuen Wai closed-road permit for the overnight window.

Similar overnight access via Lok Ma Chau is already available to private cars holding permits for Shenzhen Bay, Man Kam To and Sha Tau Kok. The department said the measure would improve convenience and support closer Guangdong-Hong Kong integration.

zh.headline: 香園圍許可證跨境私家車今起可通宵經落馬洲過境
zh.dek: 持有香園圍管制站封閉道路通行許可證的跨境私家車，由今日起每日午夜12時至上午6時30分可經落馬洲管制站過境。
body: 運輸署表示，由8月26日起，持有香園圍管制站封閉道路通行許可證的跨境私家車，可於每日午夜12時至上午6時30分的時段內經落馬洲管制站過境。
粵港兩地政府達成協議，便利獲發香園圍跨境配額的私家車在該管制站運作時間以外仍可過境。許可證持有人只須持有有效的香園圍管制站跨境私家車許可證，便可在指定通宵時段使用落馬洲管制站。
現時持有深圳灣、文錦渡及沙頭角管制站許可證的跨境私家車，已可於通宵時段經落馬洲過境。運輸署指有關安排有助提升通關便利，促進粵港進一步融合。
